content: Bark (github.com/Finb/Bark, fetched 2026-08): iOS-only push app over APNs; key per device; self-hostable bark-server; encrypted push (ciphertext AES). URL forms /:key/:body, /:key/:title/:body, /:key/:title/:subtitle/:body (GET or POST). Params: url (click-jump), group (notification grouping), icon (iOS15+, URL), sound, call (ring 30s), level (active|timeSensitive|passive|critical; critical bypasses DND/silent), isArchive/autoCopy/badge per full docs. Plain text only, newline breaks, no markdown, no server history (archive stored on device), no two-way, no multi-device-per-key. Ecosystem: Windows client, CLI, browser ext, GitHub Action, scheduled sending.
